== English Decipher comparison ==
The November 1998 Glossary changes capacity from eight passengers to one driver and seven passengers. It retains the Tatooine restriction, immediate Passenger Deck deployment and aliens' deployment discount.

Decipher, November 1998, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/fb/Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf#page=77 Glossary Version 2.0], PDF page 77. Players Committee, Decipher Errata, official text as of 1 January 2013, PDF page 15. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf#page=15 Internet Archive].
